jobs.title: Director of Operations - P&S and Options
jobs.description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and strategic leader to oversee our Global Trade Support Operations. This role is responsible for managing the day-to-day support of global trading activities across Equity, Fixed Income, and Options markets while ensuring operational excellence, regulatory compliance, risk management, and exceptional client service. The successful candidate will drive continuous process improvement, lead a high-performing global team, and partner with internal stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency and scalability.

Key Responsibilities

Lead the Global Trade Support Operations function supporting Equity, Fixed Income, and Options trading activities across global markets.
Oversee daily and weekly Options expiration processing, including monthly Saturday expirations, ensuring timely and accurate execution.
Review daily operational exception volumes, prioritize issues, and drive timely resolution through appropriate escalation and follow-up.
Evaluate and enhance the Operational Risk Framework to ensure effective controls, regulatory compliance, and risk mitigation.
Manage day-to-day client relationships, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are consistently achieved and client expectations are exceeded.
Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics, providing monthly trend analysis and actionable recommendations to senior management.
Analyze staffing models, workload drivers, and operational performance to optimize resource allocation and improve productivity.
Identify and implement operational efficiencies by leveraging technology, automation, and industry best practices.
Oversee operational business continuity planning, ensuring procedures and documentation remain current, comprehensive, and aligned with organizational standards.
Develop, implement, and maintain Written Supervisory Procedures (WSPs) across the global operations team to support governance, compliance, and consistent execution.
Foster a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, collaboration, and operational excellence across a geographically dispersed team.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
Significant experience leading global trade support or securities operations within the financial services industry.
Strong knowledge of Equity, Fixed Income, Options, and post-trade operational processes.
Demonstrated experience in operational risk management, regulatory compliance, and supervisory control frameworks.
Proven ability to lead global teams and manage complex operational environments.
Strong analytical skills with experience developing and interpreting operational metrics and performance trends.
Experience driving process improvements, workflow optimization, and technology-enabled operational efficiencies.
Exceptional client relationship management, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

Preferred Skills

Knowledge of global securities markets and settlement practices.
Experience implementing automation initiatives and operational transformation projects.
Strong leadership, coaching, and change management capabilities.
Ability to influence cross-functional partners and drive strategic initiatives across global organizations.

Compensation Range: The salary range for this position is between $150k-$175k. Broadridge considers various factors when evaluating a candidate's final salary including, but not limited to, relevant experience, skills, and education.

Bonus Eligibility: Bonus Eligible

Benefits Information: Please visit www.broadridgebenefits.com for more information on our comprehensive benefit offerings

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. We believe that associates do their best when they feel safe, understood, and valued, and we work diligently and collaboratively to ensure Broadridge is a company—and ultimately a community—that recognizes and celebrates everyone’s unique perspective.

These tools are used only to support our recruiters and hiring managers, and all employment decisions include human review to ensure fairness, accuracy, and compliance with applicable laws. Please note that honesty and transparency are critical to our hiring process. Any attempt to falsify, misrepresent, or disguise information in an application, resume, assessment, or interview will result in disqualification from consideration.

We recognize that ensuring our long-term success means creating an environment where everyone is welcome, where everyone's strengths are valued, and where everyone can perform at their best. jobs.title: Executive Director, Business Systems & PMO
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Executive Director, Business Systems and Project Management Office
(PMO) is a senior IT leader responsible for the strategy, governance, and operational excellence of enterprise business systems and IT project delivery. The role oversees three key areas:

Enterprise resource planning (ERP), with a primary focus on Workday;
Research administration systems supporting the sponsored research enterprise
The IT PMO, which oversees prioritization, delivery, and portfolio management for institution-wide technology initiatives.

This leader will partner across Finance, HR, Research, clinical operations, and academic leadership to translate institutional strategy into effective systems and project portfolios.

This is a hybrid role with a monthly onsite expectation.

Key Responsibilities

Business Systems & Research Administration

Lead the strategy, roadmap, governance, and lifecycle management of Workday and related enterprise business applications.
Direct teams responsible for system support, configuration, integrations, security, enhancements, and optimization.
Partner with Finance, HR, Payroll, and Supply Chain to ensure systems align with institutional, regulatory, and operational requirements.
Provide systems leadership for research administration, including pre- and post-award, grants management, compliance, and financial systems.
Lead the implementation, integration, and optimization of research administration platforms.
Advance AI integration, automation, self-service, reporting, and operational efficiency.

IT Project Management Office

Lead the enterprise IT PMO, including portfolio governance, intake and prioritization, delivery methodology, resource planning, and reporting.
Ensure effective delivery across clinical, administrative, research, business, and infrastructure initiatives.
Provide portfolio reporting to senior leadership, including project status, risk, capacity, and financial performance.
Drive continuous improvement in project delivery, tools, and change management practices.

Enterprise Partnership & Leadership

Ensure systems and technology initiatives align with healthcare regulatory requirements and broader clinical and IT strategy.
Partner across clinical informatics, EHR, infrastructure, and cybersecurity to ensure effective integration.
Build trusted relationships across Finance, HR, Research, clinical operations, and Health Affairs, translating between technical teams and executive, physician, faculty, and administrative stakeholders.
Manage strategic vendor relationships and represent business systems and PMO priorities in IT governance and capital planning.
Lead and develop multidisciplinary teams and foster accountability, service excellence, and continuous improvement.
Manage budgets, staffing, and vendor resources and establish KPIs for systems performance, project delivery, and team effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in IT, business management, or related field required; MBA or MHA preferred.
15+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including significant ERP experience in a large, complex organization.
Experience in a university-affiliated academic medical center or large integrated health system.
Experience with Workday and familiarity with grants management/eRA platforms and ERP integrations.
Proven experience establishing or leading an IT PMO, including portfolio governance and delivery methodology.
Knowledge of healthcare regulatory and compliance requirements, including HIPAA and HITECH.
Change management expertise supporting large-scale system implementations.
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams and managing significant technology budgets.
Exceptional executive communication, relationship management, and stakeholder influence skills.
Executive presence and ability to operate effectively with senior leadership while remaining hands-on when needed.

The posted pay range is Boston Children’s reasonable and good-faith expectation for this pay at the time of posting.

Any base pay offer provided depends on skills, experience, education, certifications, and a variety of other job-related factors. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive benefits package that includes flexible schedules, affordable health, vision and dental insurance, child care and student loan subsidies, generous levels of time off, 403(b) Retirement Savings plan, Pension, Tuition and certain License and Certification Reimbursement, cell phone plan discounts and discounted rates on T-passes. Experience the benefits of passion and teamwork.

jobs.description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).

This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.

Executive Director, Global ESG Regulatory Compliance

Reporting to: SVP, Chief Legal Corporate Responsibility Officer

Why Work at Lenovo

We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.

Lenovo is a US$83 billion global technology powerhouse, ranked #196 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its leadership in devices, infrastructure, and solutions to drive innovation across the technology landscape. Our continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere.

Description And Requirements

Lenovo is seeking a strategic, business-solutions-driven leader to serve as Executive Director, Global ESG Regulatory Compliance. This role reports to the SVP, Chief Legal Corporate Responsibility Officer and is responsible for leading Lenovo’s global ESG reporting, sustainability regulatory compliance, and product environmental compliance programs.

This role plays a critical part in enabling business growth and market access by ensuring compliance with evolving global regulatory requirements while supporting customer and investor expectations. In addition, the Executive Director oversees enterprise ISO management systems (ISO 9001, 14001, 50001) and aligns ESG and compliance programs with customer sustainability requirements, ecolabel expectations, and commercial needs.

Key responsibilities include leading global ESG disclosures (including HKEX and CSRD readiness), defining enterprise ESG strategy and commitments (including net-zero and 2030 ESG KPIs), and managing external ESG ratings and surveys (e.g., CDP, EcoVadis, MSCI). The role oversees product and environmental regulatory compliance programs and governance structures, including the Product Compliance Review Board and associated tools and processes, and leads the preparation and delivery of ESG updates and materials to executive leadership and the Board of Directors. The role also owns the systems, tools, and digital infrastructure that enable ESG reporting and regulatory compliance, including advancing automation and AI-enabled capabilities.

The Executive Director will serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, engaging regularly with executive teams on ESG performance, regulatory developments, and risk management. The role also supports investor engagement, customer ESG requirements, and external interactions with regulators and industry groups to anticipate and influence evolving standards.

This position leads a global, multi-disciplinary team spanning ESG reporting, regulatory compliance, and ISO management systems, and is responsible for building scalable processes and capabilities to manage increasing regulatory complexity.

Basic Qualifications

15+ years’ experience in ESG, sustainability regulation, regulatory compliance, or related field
Strong knowledge of global ESG frameworks and regulations, including HKEX, CSRD, and related regimes
Demonstrated ability to translate regulatory requirements into scalable business processes and controls
Experience leading complex, global compliance or reporting programs
Proven ability to manage large, distributed, and specialized teams
Strong cross-functional leadership and executive stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

Experience managing product and environmental regulatory compliance programs
Experience with ESG reporting, data, and compliance tools and platforms
Familiarity with ISO management systems and certification processes
Experience supporting investor, customer, and ESG ratings/survey requirements
Experience engaging with senior leadership and contributing to executive-level governance discussions
Strong strategic thinking, problem-solving, and risk management skills

Desired Skills

Strategic agility and ability to operate in a fast-moving, global environment
Strong executive presence and ability to influence senior stakeholders
Ability to anticipate and proactively manage regulatory and reputational risks
Collaborative leadership style with strong team development capabilities
Clear and effective communication skills across technical and executive audiences

The base salary budgeted range for this position is $200k - 250K. Individuals may also be considered for bonus and/or commission.

Lenovo’s various benefits can be found on www.lenovobenefits.com.

In compliance with Colorado's EPEWA, the expected application deadline for this position is August 27, 2026. This applies to both external and internal candidates.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.

jobs.description:

Emergency Medicine

Job Summary:

Centerpoint Medical Center is launching a new ACGME-accredited Emergency Medicine residency program in the Kansas City Metro.

Strong partnership with executive leadership and support from an established GME office

Leadership scope and compensation aligned with senior academic and institutional responsibility

Full founding authority over program design, curriculum philosophy, trainee experience, and program culture, including meaningful decision‑making input into early core faculty selection.

Includes active participation in the GMEC and input into broader workforce and physician development strategy
Works in direct partnership with the Designated Institutional Official and executive leadership

Clinical Emergency Medicine - 20%

Sustains clinical credibility without distracting from leadership priorities

Incentives/Benefits Package:

Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision insurance, 401k with match, PTO, and more
CME time and allowance
Malpractice coverage
Employee Stock Purchase Plan

About Centerpoint Medical Center:

Centerpoint Medical Center features 285+ private rooms, 440+ physicians on the medical staff, a strong complement of subspecialists, and 1300+ staff.
Centerpoint Medical Center is unlike any other hospital in eastern Jackson County. Our campus includes the latest healthcare technology and offers innovative programs and services for patients and their families.
The medical center offers high-tech care in a beautiful, comfortable setting designed to exceed the expectations of those we serve.
Hospital & ER features include the only Level II Trauma Center in eastern Jackson County; an accredited chest pain center and variety of cardiovascular services; orthopedic services including total joint and sports medicine; stroke center with Joint Commission Primary Stroke Center Certification; women’s services; among many others.

The Kansas City region is a two-state region home to more than 2.5 million people as well as home to corporate headquarter giants including Cerner, AMC, Garmin, Hallmark, and H&R Block, among many others. KCI Airport features 10 major airlines and the fewest flight delays, making travel easy. With non-stop flights available, you can be on either coast in 3 hours or less. For the food enthusiast, KC features four James Beard Award winning chefs and about a dozen finalists. Kansas City ranked No. 19 on Forbes' list of the 20 Happiest Cities to Work in Right Now. Overland Park, a suburb of Kansas City located in Johnson County, ranked #1 for 'best places to raise a family. Centerpoint Medical Center is launching a new ACGME-accredited Emergency Medicine residency program in the Kansas City Metro.

Hospital & ER features include the only Level II Trauma Center in eastern Jackson County; an accredited chest pain center and variety of cardiovascular services; orthopedic services including total joint and sports medicine; stroke center with Joint Commission Primary Stroke Center Certification; women’s services; among many others.

Overland Park, a suburb of Kansas City located in Johnson County, ranked #1 for 'best places to raise a family.
